test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In October 2024, the Indian government notified rules under the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2023. What was a key objective of this legislation?

options.text: To convert minor offenses under various laws from criminal to civil penalties
To legalise digital signatures for land registration documents
To expand the RTI Act to cover private educational institutions
To establish a unified grievance redressal portal for all central ministries

solution:
The correct answer is __**To convert minor offenses under various laws from criminal to civil penalties**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2023, aims to promote ease of business by reducing compliance burdens.
 
• It seeks to convert minor offenses under 42 legislations from criminal offenses to civil penalties, fostering a business-friendly environment.
 
• The law aims to decriminalize petty offenses across various domains, including trade, commerce, and industry.
 
• By reducing criminal penalties for minor infractions, the Act encourages entrepreneurship and reduces fear of legal repercussions for small errors.
 
• The Act aligns with the government’s broader agenda of improving India's ranking in the Ease of Doing Business index.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decriminalization of Offenses:**

 
 
• Decriminalization involves removing criminal penalties for certain acts, replacing them with civil penalties or administrative actions.
 
• This approach is used to reduce the burden on the judiciary and improve compliance without harsh legal consequences.
 
 
 
• **Ease of Doing Business:**
 
 
• India has been working to improve its Ease of Doing Business ranking globally, focusing on streamlining regulations and reducing barriers for businesses.
 
• Measures like decriminalization of minor offenses are integral to achieving this goal.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Business Ecosystem:**
 
 
• By converting criminal penalties to civil penalties, businesses can avoid lengthy legal disputes and focus on growth.
 
• This reform benefits startups and small enterprises, encouraging innovation and entrepreneurship.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Scope:**
 
 
• The Jan Vishwas Act amends 42 laws, including regulations related to environment, labor, and consumer protection.
 
• It ensures uniformity in penalties and simplifies compliance frameworks across sectors.
